reviews.text: Took 4 of my babies to get neutered/ spayed through the years. Always find good service everyone is welcoming.
Great service

They receptionist have a nasty attitude no hello or anything just walk up and sign in.  I get that you have to deal with people day in and day out but no need to push that onto others. I hope in the future they find better staff. Dont get me started on how they didnt bother trying to help me out at the end or try to give me other options.
I've trusted the experience of the vets here for many years for the spaying and neutering of my TNR'd cats as well as the kitties I've kept throughout the years.
Nice friendly employees, very helpful.
They do excellent work.  💜 …
I have taken many feral cats for TNR to this clinic. They have been a great resource for keeping the feral community healthy and safe.

The only think I ask myself is why are there so very, very few of the well priced, professional people,  superb work and environmental minded veterinary locations in Chicago?
Thanks to all of you there at PAWS.

A stray cat where I live, could not afford to keep him.  I wanted him to have a loving home before he succumb to the streets.  Strays deserve love and care .  Veterinarians should be ashamed for charging outrageous prices, and making it so hard for fur parents to keep their Babies.
Good experience all around! I think they even trimmed my pup's claws while she was under, which was so kind

Setting up the appointment on the website is easy enough as long as you have a computer, but once you find the clinic, sign in, they call you, you answer a few questions, and then you come back to pick up your baby—simple process aside from occasional tantrums from the other pets😂. My overall experience was good 👍🏾

I took my cat to get fixed at this location, I had my doubts due to her declining health, and if they would’ve told me that she wasn’t in a good state to proceed with the procedure I would’ve been fine with that because they do indeed do a checkup before going forward. She was also fixed when she was in heat, which was going to make her recovery longer and painful. Due to the stress of the surgery, she died last night.

I do not want to blame this place for negligence, I would say it was both of us. On my part, I shouldn’t have taken her to get fixed knowing her condition, yet the decision alone wasn’t mine to make.

I will keep bringing any animals that come my way in need to get fixed because this place is definitely great. Just made the wrong decision.
I hate u tongue emoji
Excellent service very nice ppl Highly recommend
True professionals. Staff are very kind and patient when explaining medication and discharge info. Spay was quick and clean with no complications. By far the best prices too. Can’t thank them enough.
They are truly the best at what they do

Love this place they are always nice and helpful! While it can be hard to get an appointment, it's by far the lowest cost way to get your cat setup, especially if you are in a targeted zip code.

Even better they have a great feral cat package if you are looking to tnr
They did a very good work on my animal's Every friendly and helpful they are awesome. ☺️
I appreciate the service that was provided to my dog and I
I was a little scared to take my dog there due to the reviews but I’m so happy I did , they were so nice with me and my dog and took the time to explain everything to detail
I a first time cat mom and they guided me with a lot of patience when i went to spay my baby
They help with low income go Dr's. Didn't pay anything for my dog's Xray shots were free. Depending on your information to see if you qualify all them.

IF YOU WANT TO WASTE YOUR TIME BEING STRUNG ALONG, IGNORED AND REJECTED BY RUDE, LYING EMPLOYEES GO TO PAWS CHICAGO! I feed stray cats and of course one of them got pregnant. I brought her inside and took care of mom and her two kittens but I could not keep them became I already have 5 other furbabies that mom didn't get along with. I knew mom had to nurse atleast 3mths so in the meantime I called 10-15 no kill shelters desperately trying to surrender this sweet cat family. I'd used Paws Chicago spay/neuter program years ago so was familiar with their services. I was not a fan of the their cold/distant/nonchalant employees but I tried to ignore it for the greater good of the furbabies. They NEVER answer the phone so I communicated via email for a month trying to organize the drop-off. Even years later, I encountered the same type of employees. They initially pretended like they would help this cat family but that suddenly downgraded to "moms not adoptive, only wanted her kids". FINE! Even human babies in foster care are more desirable than older kids. So I tried to make an appt for surrendering the kittens. SILENCE. I tried a 3rd time WHY!!! CALL ME CRAZY I APPLIED TWICE TO BE A CAT COLONY CARETAKER WITH PAWS AND NEVER HEARD BACK. Then I get an email "We will not offer a timeframe for drop-off" W Y L I E  ,YET YOUR LITTLE VILLAGE LOCATION IS CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC WITHOUT AN APPT WHICH YOU WONT GIVE ME. So basically NOW you don't even want the kitten but your staff is either too stupid or patronizing to just say that. THANKS FOR WASTING MONTHS OF MY TIME THAT COULD HAVE BEEN USED ON A BUSINESS WITH DECENT STAFF WHO SAY WHAT THEY MEAN AND HONOR WHAT THEY AGREE TO DO!
